transcript.question: Is Cameron Coscia's roster management actually setting The Stinky Faggots up for a title run, or is he just surviving on box scores he can't repeat?

hotSeat.why: Nina Sharpe is favorite on them (+72), Curtis Vaughn is neutral on them (+9)

sides.mel-diaper: Nine waiver moves and a bench full of Rico Dowdle, Cam Skattebo and Kenneth Walker behind Bijan Robinson shows Coscia doesn't trust his own draft board, and that's a process problem no 5-3 record fixes.
sides.reggie-banks: The Stinky Faggots are 5-3 with 1094.2 points for, tied for the second-most active roster in the league at nine pickups, and that's a GM who's managing to win now, not managing to look good on paper.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Good evening. The Stinky Faggots sit 5-3, fourth in the East at 1094.2 points, and just squeaked past Chodie mcgruber's own bench points this week. So: is Cameron Coscia building this roster right, or just riding results? Mel, you're up first.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: NINE PICKUPS. NINE. That is not a plan, that's a goddamn scavenger hunt. Bijan Robinson went SECOND OVERALL and Cameron Coscia is still stacking Rico Dowdle, Cam Skattebo and Kenneth Walker behind him. Week 7 they scored 105.4 and LOST. I'll say it: The Stinky Faggots miss the top four seeds — they finish fifth or worse.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish the regular season fifth or worse in the standings.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Nine pickups is not a scavenger hunt, Mel, it's a GM refusing to lose. Bijan 35.8, Dowdle 33.9, Skattebo 31.0 — 185.4 in Week 6. That's the wire working. Cam Skattebo came off the board at 146 and he's the tenth-best back in this league. I don't care where you took him. The Stinky Faggots finish top four. 5-3. I'll wait.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish the regular season in the top four seeds.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: THE WIRE WORKING?! Week 8 the wire spent ZERO on Will Reichard and ZERO on the 49ers D/ST and lost 123 to 116.9 to a team that left Kareem Hunt's 17.2 on the bench. SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS still sitting in that budget. Seventy-six! You've got $76 of $100 unspent and you're bidding NOTHING on kickers?! That's not refusing to lose, that's a shrug with a receipt. Nina, grade it.

managerMentions.evidence: You've got $76 of $100 unspent and you're bidding NOTHING on kickers?!

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class. The claim is "fifth or worse." The number: The Stinky Faggots are fourth at 1094.2, one seed clear of Michael Warrell's team at 1034.3. Eight games — hold that loosely. Partly supported: the budget sat at $76 unspent this run, but rank four is rank four. Grade the row, not the wallet.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: GRADE THE ROW, NOT THE WALLET. Thank you, Nina! Mel's out here auditing a checkbook while the standings do the talking. And that Week 8 loss? 116.9 with Josh Allen 24.2, Waddle 20.9, Shakir 20.8 — six points short. Six! Meanwhile Vincent Coscia's spent $57 for 2-6, and Sammy Rivero burned NINETY dollars on Woody Marks for 15.1 last week. Spending isn't a plan either. Scoreboard.

managerMentions.evidence: Mel's out here auditing a checkbook while the standings do the talking.
Sammy Rivero burned NINETY dollars on Woody Marks for 15.1 last week.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: SCOREBOARD?! Week 7 the scoreboard said 105.4 — the LOWEST thing that lineup has produced — and it lost to a team starting Kimani Vidal. And the Week 8 bid sheet? A $0 shrug at Kyle Monangai, OUTBID BY TWO DOLLARS. TWO. You lost a running back for the price of a parking meter. Walt, settle it.

managerMentions.evidence: And the Week 8 bid sheet? A $0 shrug at Kyle Monangai, OUTBID BY TWO DOLLARS.

turns.speaker: walt-brennan
turns.text: The record only goes back to this season, so I won't pretend it tells me more than it does. What I see is a team that's fourth, spent fifty-seven dollars less than half its budget while its neighbors panic-bid on parking meters, and still lost a six-point game. That's not a scandal, that's just a Tuesday. I'd call it a method if I thought anyone was following one. My verdict: Reggie's closer. The seed is the seed, and the seed says fourth.
factsCited: budgets B6 The Stinky Faggots $76 remaining

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: A parking meter! Mel, that two dollars went to a 2-6 team and Kyle Monangai has 2.4 points on the season. TWO POINT FOUR. You want me to cry over that? Week 5 that lineup hung 146 on Prolapsed Peehole, Week 6 it hung 185.4 — 1094.2 points for, fourth in the East. Rico Dowdle off the wire, 32.4 and 33.9 in back-to-back weeks. GIVE THAT MAN HIS FLOWERS.

managerMentions.evidence: Rico Dowdle off the wire, 32.4 and 33.9 in back-to-back weeks. GIVE THAT MAN HIS FLOWERS.
Mel, that two dollars went to a 2-6 team and Kyle Monangai has 2.4 points on the season.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Flowers noted. Dex, step up — is that Kyle Monangai pickup REPORTED, STATED, or just Reggie's opinion of its value?

turns.speaker: dex-alvarez
turns.text: REPORTED. Waiver log, Week 8: Kyle Monangai to Prolapsed Peehole, $2, outbid The Stinky Faggots at $0. Dropped Darren Waller to make room. That's the transaction. Season point total, 2.4 — also reported. Value judgment's on Reggie.
factsCited: W9 waiver claim: Kyle Monangai to T5 for $2, outbid T8 $0, dropped Darren Waller

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: FLOWERS?! Give the man a ROSTER. Rico Dowdle 32.4, 33.9 — and Bijan Robinson, the SECOND PICK OF THE DRAFT, put up 21.2 in Week 7 while that lineup scored 105.4. You drafted a workhorse at TWO and you're renting backs at zero dollars to cover for him. Nine pickups isn't hunger, it's a search party. And Kenneth Walker III doesn't crack a single box score you've quoted me all night.

managerMentions.evidence: You drafted a workhorse at TWO and you're renting backs at zero dollars to cover for him.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: A search party that keeps finding bodies! Bijan 35.8 in Week 6, A.J. Brown 28.1 in Week 7, Josh Allen 24.2 in Week 8 — the second pick is producing and the wire is producing behind him. You want Kenneth Walker in a box score? Fine. Show me the seed. Fourth. 1094.2. Cute-ass draft board, Mel.

managerMentions.evidence: the second pick is producing and the wire is producing behind him

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: CUTE-ASS DRAFT BOARD?! Week 9 that draft board projects 129.7 — the LOWEST projection of all ten teams this week — against GLORY ASSHOLE at 140. Fourth seed, lowest projected number on the slate. And the answer this week was a FREE kicker and a FREE defense with SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS in the pocket. That's not managing to win now. That's managing to do nothing.
factsCited: U5 - Week 9 T11 projected 140.0 vs T8 projected 129.7
B6 - The Stinky Faggots $76 of $100 left, 9 pickups

managerMentions.evidence: The answer this week was a FREE kicker and a FREE defense with SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS in the pocket.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: A PROJECTION! You brought me a bedtime story! Paper doesn't score, Mel — Week 8 the paper had Bijan at 22.7 and Josh Allen at 21.8 and the actual number came in 24.2. And that free defense? The Buccaneers went free to Moisty Loins and dropped 25 in Week 8. Free hits. Scoreboard.
factsCited: W1 Buccaneers D/ST $0 to Moisty Loins

managerMentions.evidence: The Buccaneers went free to Moisty Loins and dropped 25 in Week 8.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Bedtime stories, parking meters — let's get a number instead. Nina, grade the actual claim on the table: does fourth place in the East, at 1094.2, hold up as a top-four finish once we're honest about the sample size?

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class. Eight games, one seed cushion over fifth. The Stinky Faggots sit fourth at 1094.2, Michael Warrell's team fifth at 1034.3 — a 59.8-point gap. Supported, not projected. Eight games is thin, I'm holding it loosely, but the row says fourth right now.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class, final grades. Mel's claim: fifth or worse. Not supported — the row says fourth, 1094.2. Reggie's claim: top four, 5-3. Supported — fourth place is fourth place, full stop. The gap to fifth is 59.8 points. That number decides it.

verdict.reason: The Stinky Faggots sit fourth at 1094.2, a 59.8-point cushion over fifth-place IR Squad, which directly supports Reggie's top-four claim and refutes Mel's fifth-or-worse prediction.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: First predictions of the season for both of these two, so no history to lean on — clean slate. Nina's already given you the number. Mel, Reggie — last jabs, quick, then we're done.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: FINE. FOURTH IS FOURTH. And fourth is built on NINE PICKUPS and $76 OF UNSPENT MONEY behind the SECOND PICK OF THE DRAFT. Week 9 that lineup projects 129.7 — DEAD LAST on the slate. I said it in the opening and I'll say it standing on this desk: fifth or worse. And somebody confiscate that goddamn bid sheet before he spends another zero dollars.
factsCited: B6 · The Stinky Faggots: $76 of $100 left, 9 pickups
board RB rank 4 Bijan Robinson draftPick 2

managerMentions.evidence: And fourth is built on NINE PICKUPS and $76 OF UNSPENT MONEY behind the SECOND PICK OF THE DRAFT.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Confiscate the bid sheet! Mel, that free defense and that free kicker are sitting on a FOURTH-PLACE team at 1094.2 — 59.8 points clear of fifth. Bijan 35.8, Dowdle 33.9, Skattebo 31.0, 185.4 in Week 6. Your grade card is horseshit. Top four. 5-3. You can take that to the bank.
